arxiv-1812-07978.title: Inference with Hamiltonian Sequential Monte Carlo Simulators
arxiv-1812-07978.creator: Remi Daviet
arxiv-1812-07978.description: Abstract The paper proposes a new Monte-Carlo simulator combining the advantages of Sequential Monte Carlo simulators and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo simulators. The result is a method that is robust to multimodality and complex shapes to use for inference in presence of difficult likelihoods or target functions. Several examples are provided.

arxiv-2209-11804.title: Incommensurate magnetic ordering in CrB 2
arxiv-2209-11804.creator: A Deák, J Jackson, B Nyári, L Szunyogh
arxiv-2209-11804.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by A Deák, J Jackson, B Nyári, L Szunyogh. Incommensurate magnetism in CrB 2 is studied in terms of a spin model based on density functional theory calculations. Heisenberg exchange interactions derived from the paramagnetic phase using the disordered local moment theory show significant differences compared with those resulting from the treatment of the material as a ferromagnet; of these two methods, the disordered local moment theory is found to give a significantly more realistic description.

arxiv-2311-02749.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Elham Amin Mansour, Hehui Zheng, Robert K. Katzschmann. The world around us is full of soft objects we perceive and deform with dexterous hand movements. For a robotic hand to control soft objects, it has to acquire online state feedback of the deforming object. While RGB-D cameras can collect occluded point clouds at a rate of 30 Hz 30\text{\,}\mathrm{Hz} , this does not represent a continuously trackable object surface.

arxiv-2411-09707.description: Abstract The detection of pilots’ mental states is critical, as abnormal mental states have the potential to cause catastrophic accidents. arxiv-2501-19252.title: Inference-Time Text-to-Video Alignment with Diffusion Latent Beam Search
arxiv-2501-19252.creator: Yuta Oshima, Masahiro Suzuki, Yutaka Matsuo, Hiroki Furuta
arxiv-2501-19252.description: Abstract The remarkable progress in text-to-video diffusion models enables the generation of photorealistic videos, although the content of these generated videos often includes unnatural movement or deformation, reverse playback, and motionless scenes. Recently, an alignment problem has attracted huge attention, where we steer the output of diffusion models based on some measure of the content’s goodness.

pmc-12386765.title: Comparative Effect of Conventional and Non-Conventional Over-the-Counter Treatments for Male Androgenetic Alopecia: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis
pmc-12386765.creator: Aditya K Gupta, Mesbah Talukder, Sharon Keene, Greg Williams, Mary A Bamimore, Kwang-Hyun Park
pmc-12386765.description: The expanding literature on nutraceuticals for male androgenetic alopecia (AGA) has inadvertently created knowledge gaps on the relative efficacy of conventional and non-conventional over-the-counter (OTC) treatments. We conducted a Bayesian network meta-analysis (NMA); the outcome measure was the 24-week change in total hair density (INPLASY202570087). We determined the relative efficacy of nine active comparators—including topical minoxidil 5% and 2%.

pmc-12578627.description: Design of on-farm experiments to achieve particular objectives, including statistical power, precision of estimates of treatment effects and spatial coverage, remains to be systematically studied. We assessed design options for an extended network to evaluate micronutrient-biofortification interventions for cereal crops in Ethiopia. We identified feasible designs to detect plausible treatment effects with power ≥0.8.

pmc-13247117.title: Pervasive non-triplet alternative splicing drives functional isoform diversity
pmc-13247117.creator: Shameerudeen Athavudeen, Neethu Issac, Adam Norris
pmc-13247117.description: Alternative mRNA splicing is an important mechanism for regulating gene expression and generating transcriptomic diversity. Most cases of alternative splicing studied to date are triplet, meaning that both isoforms retain the same translational reading frame. Indeed, non-triplet alternative splicing is sometimes considered evidence of splicing errors or noise. Nevertheless, some examples of functionally important non-triplet alternative splicing exist.

pmc-13346922.title: 3D Electrical Impedance Tomography of Regional Ventilation During Jet Ventilation: A Pilot Study
pmc-13346922.creator: Daniel S Fink, Nilton Barbosa da Rosa, Sanghee Cho, Michelle Mellenthin, Andre Vieira Pigatto, Tzu‐Jen Kao, Benjamin Cloyd, Ana Fernandez‐Bustamante, Matthew Clary, Drew Gottman, Ryan Lau, Jennifer L Mueller
pmc-13346922.description: ObjectivesLow‐frequency jet ventilation (LFJV) is commonly used in laryngotracheal surgery when intubation is not feasible. However, limited understanding of regional ventilation and distal airway pressures raises safety concerns and restricts broader adoption. This study employed electrical impedance tomography (EIT) to quantify tidal volumes and regional ventilation patterns in patients undergoing airway surgery with LFJV.

pmc-13571504.title: Macrolide-resistant Mycobacterium avium complex pulmonary disease: A narrative review
pmc-13571504.creator: Yoonis Cumar, Lina Davies Forsman, Thomas Schön, Christian Wejse, Victor Naestholt Dahl
pmc-13571504.description: Mycobacterium avium complex pulmonary disease (MAC-PD) is on the rise across the world, where only about two-thirds are cured by current treatment strategies. Treatment of MAC-PD includes macrolides as the key drug in a three-drug regimen, making the emergence of macrolide resistance particularly concerning, as treatment success is reduced to about 21%.
